description: Open the hosted preview catalog browser app. With no arguments it lists every catalog with its preview count only; pass projectId to list one catalog's previews. To find previews without the app, call catalog_list_projects, then catalog_list_previews with a catalog id. Also opens from the ChatGPT/Codex sidebar.

projectId.description: A catalog id from catalog_list_projects whose previews to list.

token.description: A grant token from poll_access, when you cannot set the X-Compose-Preview-Token header yourself — an MCP client fixes its headers at connect time, so this is how a token approved during this session is used in it. Prefer the header where you control it.

name: catalog_library
title: Preview Catalogs
